symptom: assess_stop_decision prioritized an available human dependency before checking whether an autonomous viable recovery alternative remained.
root_cause: The initial stop-decision ordering treated human availability as a stronger signal than autonomous recoverability.
early_signals: MOCATRIZ canon requires reasonable autonomous recovery before escalation

assess_stop_decision checked human dependency before viable autonomous alternatives
human_cost: The system could consume operator time and authority for a runtime failure it still had a reasonable autonomous path to resolve.
